summary: Iteration 12 verified — 992 INDB food expansion + new serving_disclaimer field is fully working on BOTH backend and frontend. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (test_iter12_indb_expansion.py). DB now holds 1027+ foods (verified with explicit limit=2000). GET /api/foods/food-rasam-with-lemon returns serving_disclaimer 'Beverage — count as FLUID intake, not just food. Values per 150ml here; a real glass is 200–250ml. Critical for fluid-restricted / dialysis patients.' (contains both 'Beverage' AND 'FLUID'). GET /api/foods/food-lauki-sabzi returns serving_disclaimer=null AND actionable_clinical_tip still starts with 'Excellent low-potassium vegetable'. Search q=rasam returns food-rasam-with-lemon (plus food-rasam-with-tamarind, food-rasam-powder). Search q=palak still returns food-palak-paneer. Regression: meal-log POST + summary GET + DELETE all 200; POST /api/favorites/food-lauki-sabzi twice toggles is_favorite; GET /api/reports/weekly returns 200 with valid payload. Frontend (Playwright 390x844, demo@renal.app login, disclaimer-accept tapped): Case A — Rasam with lemon → safety-card tapped → serving-disclaimer testID visible, inner text contains both 'Beverage' and 'FLUID'. Case B — Lauki Sabzi → serving-disclaimer element NOT rendered (query returns None), detail-portion visible, detail-tip starts with 'Excellent low-potassium'. Case C — Zero console errors on either detail page. Screenshots captured at /tmp/case_a.png and /tmp/case_b.png confirm the yellow warning box appears between Portion Limit and Clinical Tip only for Rasam (as designed). No React Native / Expo regressions.

minor.issue: Default server-side limit=100 caps the food list to 100 items even though DB now has 1027 foods. Frontend api.listFoods() never overrides limit, so users on the Search screen effectively see only the first 100 foods from Mongo's natural order. All 992 new INDB dishes are reachable ONLY via the ?q=... text-search path or explicit ?limit=... override. Recommend either (a) increase default to something like 2000 to expose the full DB, or (b) add pagination + sorting so the client can page through, or (c) at minimum have the frontend pass limit=2000 when displaying the full list. Not a functional break for the search flow the review request tests (rasam/palak/lauki are all reachable via q=) but is a discoverability regression for the food catalogue.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py L541-571: GET /api/foods has hard-coded default limit=100 without a Query() declaration or upper bound. With DB size now 1027 this is a significant discoverability gap — see 'minor' backend issue. Also `.limit(limit)` is applied without a `.sort()` so the 100 returned are in Mongo natural insertion order (curated foods first because SEED_FOODS is upserted before SEED_FOODS_INDB in the lifespan).

backend/server.py enrich_food_sync correctly forwards food.get('serving_disclaimer') into FoodOut — verified both via Rasam-with-lemon (populated) and Lauki-Sabzi (null) responses. The Pydantic model on FoodOut treats it as optional so absent field also serializes to null — good.

frontend/app/food/[id].tsx L148-153: Uses a truthy check (`detail.food.serving_disclaimer ? ... : null`) which correctly hides the yellow box for empty strings AND null AND undefined. testID='serving-disclaimer', Ionicons name='alert-circle' — matches the review-request spec exactly. Placement is between the Portion (L140-146) and Clinical Tip (L155-161) blocks as designed.

frontend/app/food/[id].tsx L261-271: disclaimerBox uses COLORS.yellowBg / yellowBorder / yellowText tokens (theme-consistent) and 44px effective touch height. Icon uses COLORS.yellowStrong for the alert-circle — consistent with iter 11 favorite-star colour palette.
frontend/src/lib/api.ts: FoodOut.serving_disclaimer typed as `string | null | undefined` — matches the backend Pydantic Optional[str] shape.
